robust-frontend-architecture-1-2026-06-1.description: A pnpm and Turborepo monorepo contains the Astro and React website plus shared UI, ESLint, and TypeScript configuration packages. The shared UI package owns the design system and theme tokens.
robust-frontend-architecture-1-2026-06-1.title: Monorepo architecture

robust-frontend-architecture-for-agentic.description: A code change passes format, lint, typecheck, knip, syncpack, test, build, publint, Playwright with axe, and Lighthouse gates before it can merge and deploy. Failing any gate stops the change.
robust-frontend-architecture-for-agentic.title: Every change has to prove itself

what-frontend-tests-are-actually-for-cov.description: For any file, ask whether it has real logic that can break in a way a user would feel. If yes, write a real behavioural test. If no, exclude it from unit-test coverage because end-to-end tests already cover it. Never write a hollow test to pad coverage.
what-frontend-tests-are-actually-for-cov.title: How a file earns a test (or doesn't)

what-frontend-tests-are-actually-for-tes.description: Unit tests with Vitest ask whether isolated logic can be quietly wrong. Component tests with Testing Library ask whether a component behaves once alive. End-to-end tests with Playwright and axe ask whether the real page loads, hydrates, and remains accessible.
what-frontend-tests-are-actually-for-tes.title: Three testing layers, three different questions
